articles.title: Is the US under cyber attack? | BBC Americast
articles.titleZh: 美国正遭受网络攻击吗？| BBC Americast
articles.summary:
After a week of tech chaos with flights grounded, plus outages at Microsoft, Apple, US banks, and the National Security Agency, questions continue to be asked about the cause of the disruption and whether it’s more than a series of coincidences.  Now the government’s top cyber security official, Sean Cairncross, is leaving his post, with CBS reporting he was fired.

Trump says these were “individual events”. But Republican Senator Josh Hawley says if it is all a coincidence, “it’s like the greatest coincidence in the history of the world”. So who’s right?
In this episode, Sarah, Marianna and Anthony discuss the doubts over the official explanation, cuts to America’s cyber defences, and whether people trust what they’re being told by the White House. 

Plus, Sarah talks to the cybersecurity and cyberespionage expert Dmitri Alperovitch about the fall of Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and the race with China over AI chips. Are rushed fixes for problems found by AI behind the disruption?

HOSTS
• Sarah Smith, North America Editor
• Marianna Spring, Social Media Investigations Senior Correspondent
• Anthony Zurcher, North America Correspondent

GUEST
• Dmitri Alperovitch, co-founder of CrowdStrike and former adviser to the US Departments of Defense and Homeland Security.  Author of World on the Brink: How America Can Beat China in the Race for the 21st Century and hosts the podcast Geopolitics Decanted.

articles.readingTextZh:
经过一周的技术混乱，航班停飞，加上微软、苹果、美国银行和国家安全局的宕机，人们仍在不断追问中断的原因，以及这是否不仅仅是一系列巧合。

如今，政府最高网络安全官员肖恩·凯恩克罗斯（Sean Cairncross）即将离职，CBS报道称他被解雇。

特朗普表示，这些是“个别事件”。

但共和党参议员乔希·霍利表示，如果这一切都是巧合，“那将是世界历史上最重大的巧合”。

So, who’s right? 谁才是正确的？

在本期节目中，Sarah、Marianna和Anthony讨论了对官方解释的质疑、美国网络防御的削减，以及人们是否相信白宫所说的话。

此外，Sarah还与网络安全和网络间谍活动专家Dmitri Alperovitch探讨了Nvidia的Jensen Huang的陨落，以及与中国在人工智能芯片领域的竞争。

是否因为要匆忙修复人工智能发现的问题而导致了服务中断？

主持人
• Sarah Smith，北美编辑
• Marianna Spring，社交媒体调查高级记者
• Anthony Zurcher，北美记者

嘉宾
• Dmitri Alperovitch，CrowdStrike联合创始人，美国国防部和国土安全部前顾问。

《世界处于危急关头：美国如何才能在21世纪的竞争中击败中国》一书的作者，并主持播客《Geopolitics Decanted》。

articles.title: What's been agreed at the EU-UK summit? | BBC Newscast
articles.titleZh: 欧盟-英国峰会上达成了哪些协议？| BBC新闻播报
articles.summary:
Today, the UK and EU have agreed three new deals on food exports, youth mobility and emissions at a summit in Brussels. However, no agreement has been reached over the question of tuition fees after the EU demanded the UK agree to cut tuition costs for European students. So what impact will this sticking point have on the deal?  

With the conversation around UK’s relationship with the European Union back in the spotlight, that can only mean one thing. The Brexitcast gang are back together. Adam is joined by Laura in the studio, and Chris and Katya are in Brussels, to unpack the day’s events.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
今天，英国和欧盟在布鲁塞尔举行的峰会上就粮食出口、青年流动和碳排放达成了三项新协议。

然而，在欧盟要求英国同意降低欧洲学生的学费之后，双方尚未就学费问题达成一致。

那么，这个棘手问题会对这笔交易产生怎样的影响？

随着英国与欧盟的关系再次成为人们关注的焦点，这只能意味着一件事。

Brexitcast团队又聚到一起了。

Adam 与 Laura 一起在演播室，Chris 和 Katya 则在布鲁塞尔，共同解读当天的事件。

articles.title: Why this Apprentice exec compares Trump presser to show's boardroom
articles.titleZh: 为什么这位《学徒》高管将特朗普的新闻发布会比作节目的董事会会议？
articles.summary: Erin Burnett speaks to a former Apprentice executive who says Trump’s press conference with Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio was reminiscent of a scene straight out of the Apprentice. He says that Vance and Rubio are essentially beginning “to audition for the job with the master making the decision” when it comes to 2028.
